todo_write.description: Append main tasks, or explicitly reorder unfinished work. Completed tasks and history are immutable. New tasks start pending.

parameters.todos: New main task descriptions. During reorder, an empty array removes unfinished tasks without adding replacements.
parameters.start: Existing task number at which to remove unfinished tasks from the current plan and append replacements. Omit to append.

todo_start.description: Start a pending main task. Earlier tasks in the current plan must be completed.

todo_finish.description: Mark the current in-progress main task completed.

todo_read.description: Read the current main task list and active local task, or export the complete task history to a temporary JSON file.

parameters.full: When true, exports the full history, including completed and removed tasks, plan changes, and local-task reports. When false or omitted, returns the current plan starting from the most recently completed task.

todo_report.description: Identify the main task and optional local task that the current work belongs to.

parameters.index: Number of the in-progress main task shown by todo_read. Switching main tasks requires the previous one to be completed or the plan to be explicitly reordered.
parameters.inLocalTask: Set true for a separate, time-consuming local task; set false for a quick routine action directly serving the main task.
parameters.localTask: A short name for the local task. Required to enter or change a local task. When inLocalTask is true, omit it to continue the current local task. When inLocalTask is false, always omit it.
